  • Constructor Details

    • Posterior

      private Posterior(ReservoirHistoryEnsemble.Candidate[] candidates, CompositionalReservoirHistory.Result[] results, double[] prior, double[] weights, List<String> rejected, double logEvidence, double rejectedMass, int bestLikelihood)
      Freezes complete evaluated hypotheses and normalized probability masses.
      Parameters:
      candidates - frozen candidate array
      results - feasible replays or null for failures
      prior - normalized prior masses including failures
      weights - normalized posterior masses
      rejected - failed candidate diagnostics
      logEvidence - log relative likelihood normalizer without common Gaussian density constants
      rejectedMass - prior probability assigned to infeasible hypotheses
      bestLikelihood - index of minimum calibration chi-square

    • getPriorStandardizedShifts

      public double[] getPriorStandardizedShifts()

    • pressureQuantiles

      public double[] pressureQuantiles(double probability)
      Returns posterior lower-tail pressure quantiles at each common time, including the initial state.

      Probability 0.1 means the lower tenth percentile, not the petroleum exceedance convention. These are uncertainty in the deterministic model predictions from the supplied scenarios, excluding future measurement noise. Held-out measurements were not used to construct them.

      Parameters:
      probability - lower-tail cumulative probability between zero and one inclusive
      Returns:
      pressure quantiles in bara at every common history/forecast time
